normative_extracts.quote: Each custom element has an associated reaction queue processed synchronously before returning to user script or during microtask checkpoints.

browser_support.notes: Autonomous custom elements (customElements.define) are Baseline Widely; Safari does not support customized built-in elements (is=...).

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Custom Elements upgrade DOM nodes via CustomElementRegistry, queuing constructor, connectedCallback, and attributeChangedCallback reactions deterministically.

production_failures.symptom: DOMException: NotSupportedError when setting attributes or appending children in constructor()
production_failures.root_cause: The HTML spec forbids modifying attributes or adding children inside a custom element's constructor during parser creation.
production_failures.mitigation: Keep constructor() strictly to super(), attachShadow(), and internal state; defer DOM work to connectedCallback().

production_failures.symptom: attributeChangedCallback never fires when element attribute mutates
production_failures.root_cause: The static get observedAttributes() getter was omitted or returned a lowercase mismatch.
production_failures.mitigation: Declare static observedAttributes = ['open', 'variant'] matching exact lowercase HTML attribute names.
